doc: map_width_for_texel(radius_km) with BOTH defaults, as the callers use it: the target texel is 3.0 km (MAP_TEXEL_KM) and the cap 16384 (MAP_MAX_WIDTH), given in params and in the constants case. The radii include widths 0.5 per cent above and below 2^4, 2^7, 2^9, 2^11, 2^12 and 2^13 at 3.0 km (a default texel off by 1 per cent flips them), the planets, 7822 and 7824 km (a width just below and just above 16384) and radii far past the cap (10000, 50000, 1e6 km give the cap 16384), and 1, 0.1, 0 and -5 km (width 2). Integers: exact.
